title: C. C. Erlund's key to his cipher writing
shelfmark: Det Kgl. Bibliotek, NKS 2003 g kvart (120 pp.)
note: Christian Christoffer Erlund (1673-1754), the post director who broke Stenbock's cipher (targets/stenbock1713). 'Nøgle til hans Cifferskrift': a key, and a sign that texts in Erlund's own cipher exist.

title: Chiffernøgle til en del danske og fremmede Ministres og Generalers Chifferskrift (early 18th century, 55 leaves)
note: Already noted in research/wainut_leads_2026-11-03. Named here because it should hold the keys of the Danish envoys whose relations are scanned on Arkivalieronline (TKUA).

title: Ciffre de anno 1700, dont S. A. S. même a Copie (on the back: 'Jacob Schmidz in Hambourg vor Baron Görtz')
note: A Holstein-Gottorp cipher of 1700 tied to Baron Görtz; a key lead for the Görtz material (DECODE R4350, already in the repo).

title: Von Ziffern, d. i. von Cantzeley- und andern verborgenen Schriften (treatise)
note: German chancery treatise on ciphers, before 1785; no ciphertext stated.
